title: Axum Ancient Feast
community: Axum — the ancient capital of the Aksumite Empire, Tigray region
author: Chef Haile
desc: Axum Ancient Feast — the food of Ethiopia's most ancient civilization: Tigrayan Zigni (ETH235), Tihlo (ETH236), Tej (ETH215), Tella (ETH216), and the coffee of the Kaffa forest. The feast that recalls the food of the Aksumite Empire — the civilization that first traded Ethiopian coffee to Arabia.
longDesc: Axum was the capital of the Aksumite Empire from the 1st to 7th centuries AD — one of the world's great ancient civilizations. The Aksumite trade routes carried Ethiopian coffee, ivory, and spices to Arabia and India. The feast food of this ancient civilization has been reconstructed from Tigrayan tradition.
steps: Days before: brew Tej and Tella.
Day of: make Zigni and Tihlo.
Serve in the ancient Tigrayan tradition.
chefTips: Axum feast must include Tej — it predates recorded Ethiopian history.
commonMistakes: Serving without Tej — the ancient drink.
healthBenefits: High protein from Zigni, barley from Tihlo, probiotics from Tej and Tella.
culturalNote: Axum is the oldest city in sub-Saharan Africa and the capital of one of the ancient world's great empires. The food that the Aksumite Empire served at its feasts — tej, tella, zigni — is still prepared by the descendants of those ancient cooks in the same highland landscape.
